source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Boot into OS and load driver, stress the module
2. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist to check the sensor will change

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power sensor should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.

original_test_intent: Validate the single PWR_STBY_HSC sensor in every Project-required standby/host power state: prove its identity and measurement accuracy, demonstrate a bounded causal response in the actual standby rail domain, and separately verify any approved threshold event, protection behavior and recovery.
original_method: The Master boots the OS, loads a GPU driver, stresses a module and reads `ipmitool sdr elist`. It does not show that active GPU load is electrically coupled to the standby HSC rail, nor define the power state in which PWR_STBY_HSC is expected to vary.
manual_activity: An engineer identifies the exact standby rail and its source/load path, selects the required host/BMC state matrix, approves a causal non-destructive stimulus or state transition, and remains present with management-recovery and power authority.
required_inputs: Vendor/Project definitions of STBY and HSC, the physical monitor/controller and whether PWR_STBY_HSC represents power, current-derived power or another calculated value
Board power tree showing rail source, always-on/standby loads, management dependencies, host off/on applicability and any GPU coupling
Approved disposition of the copied GPU-driver step: demonstrated causal use, corrected Review-layer stimulus, or explicit unverified original-method coverage
Sensor/SDR identity, units, scaling, update and averaging interval, normal range by required power state, accuracy/tolerance, warning/critical thresholds and hysteresis
Expected SEL/event, management continuity, fan, rail protection, host response and deassert behavior for each authorized checkpoint
Supported workload/state-control package, maintenance approval, OOB recovery path, abort limits, evidence clock and restoration owner
safety_requirements: Do not infer that GPU stress loads the standby rail, guess raw IPMI bytes, change host power state or manipulate an always-on rail until the approved power tree and causal method are available.
Preserve the source `ipmitool sdr elist` checkpoint when the named record is exposed; any vendor or Redfish alternative is a documented Project Override and does not validate the original IPMI path.
Keep BMC/OOB management and recovery power observable throughout; an unexpected loss or reset of the standby domain is an immediate stop, not a stimulus to repeat.
Do not hot-plug, remove AC, short/load the rail, alter thresholds, inject over-current or force a protection trip unless a separately approved procedure defines limits and recovery.
Continuously monitor rail voltage/current/power, PWR_STBY_HSC, HSC/controller faults, BMC reachability/reset reason, host power state, fans, temperatures and SEL/audit logs.

On instability, unexpected state transition or loss of telemetry, stop the approved stimulus, preserve first-fault evidence, do not clear logs, reset, cycle power or auto-retry, and hand recovery to the engineer.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, bind the sensor to the exact rail/controller, capture high-level IPMI and independent electrical/management baselines in each required power state, and document filter latency.
Run only the approved bounded standby-domain load or supervised state transition while time-aligning sensor, rail, BMC continuity/reset, host state, fan, temperature, SEL and audit evidence.
Report separately: sensor identity/accuracy, causal dynamic response, threshold assert/deassert and protection/recovery. A static reading or GPU workload without proven coupling is partial only.

Restore only through the pre-approved sequence and verify the standby rail, BMC management, host state and sensor stabilize; do not invent commands, power-cycle, alter limits, retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the STBY/HSC definition, power-tree mapping, state matrix, IPMI record, tolerances, thresholds and expected management/protection behavior.
Accept or replace the GPU-driver stimulus in the Review/Project layer while preserving the Master, and approve any service-impacting state transition plus recovery.
Assess rail or management anomalies and issue the final sensor, state and overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The placeholder is non-runnable and correctly avoids guessed bytes, but raw access is not required by the Master. It also fails to expose that the copied GPU workload may have no standby-domain causal effect.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: First validate PWR_STBY_HSC through the source high-level SDR path, then use the Project-approved standby-domain stimulus or state matrix with independent rail and management telemetry. Record any alternate tool or corrected stimulus as an override.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PWR_STBY_HSC, the GPU-driver note, OS/module stress, `ipmitool sdr elist`, script and 5/10-minute estimates remain unchanged as source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT STANDBY POWER-STATE AND CAUSAL-STIMULUS CONTRACT REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map the standby rail and dependencies, establish readings in each required power state, apply only a bounded causally connected load or approved state transition, correlate the sensor with independent rail and management evidence, separately assess protection checkpoints, then restore and prove OOB/host recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board standby/always-on power tree, HSC/monitor implementation, management dependencies, BMC/SDR and host power-state design.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board revision, BMC/SDR/HSC/controller firmware, BIOS, stimulus/control tool and electrical telemetry versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project schematic and standby rail budget, sensor/SDR definition, management-power dependency, power-state behavior, limits and recovery specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces an unproven GPU-load assumption in the Review layer with a power-tree-backed standby-domain checkpoint matrix while preserving all Master text.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static visibility validates only readout; GPU load validates dynamic behavior only when coupling is proven; threshold/protection and each required power state remain separate coverage claims.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Rail/state map, causal method, sensor contract, limits/events, management recovery and approval.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Standby power may feed BMC or recovery circuits across host states; an incorrect transition can remove the control path needed to observe or recover the DUT.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may define a safe standby load, use a supported state transition or prove that GPU activity legitimately affects this rail. It must record original versus actual method, engineer approval, equivalence and unverified coverage; read-only data alone cannot complete the dynamic/protection purpose.
expected_evidence: STBY/HSC definition, board power-tree excerpt and exact PWR_STBY_HSC rail/controller/sensor/SDR identity
Required host/BMC power-state matrix with expected range, units/scaling/filtering, thresholds/events and tolerance
Engineer disposition of the copied GPU step plus approved causal stimulus/state-transition plan, abort and recovery
Unaltered high-level IPMI output and synchronized independent rail voltage/current/power, BMC continuity/reset, host state, fan/temperature, SEL/audit timeline
Separately labelled sensor-accuracy, dynamic-response, threshold assert/deassert and protection coverage, including any unexecuted checkpoint
Restored standby rail, continuous or recovered OOB management, intended host state, stable sensor/thermal/fan state, preserved first fault and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items name a standby HSC power sensor, but Procedure explicitly labels it a GPU sensor and prescribes booted-OS GPU-driver stress without any power-tree evidence that the standby rail changes. The Master is preserved; Project/engineer must confirm or replace the causal method in the Review layer.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target and desired sensor/protection behavior are identifiable. A Project schematic, power-state specification and engineer-approved causal method can resolve the copied Procedure mismatch; therefore execution readiness is pending, not permanently BLOCKED under ED-36.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the no-guessed-byte boundary but restores the explicit high-level IPMI method and identifies the missing causal standby contract.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its core source-conflict finding but changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION because the rail/state/stimulus contract is supplyable Project evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Changes its permanent block to an engineer-owned readiness gate, and adds separate power-state, management-continuity and coverage checkpoints.

review_improvement: Prevents active GPU stress or a static sensor read from being misreported as standby-rail validation and protects the management power path needed for recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: A standby sensor can remain nearly constant while active GPU rails vary, so correlation requires the actual board power tree and state-dependent load path. The source conflict is real but eliminable: once the rail, required states and safe causal stimulus are defined, collection is automatable while power-state authority and verdict remain engineer-owned.
